# Step - to_graph

`to_graph` · category: [Running and showing results](../../traversal/step_reference.md#running-and-showing-results)

Runs the traversal and builds a new graph from the edges it yields, both endpoints included (Graphersal terminal).

## Forms

```text
to_graph()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).out_e().to_graph().v().count().next()   // 4
```
